prompt: Modern cozy pixel art. A cute chibi character, exactly 2 heads tall: a big round head about as tall as the whole body below it, short stubby limbs, like a classic cute RPG sprite. Ancient Chinese wuxia (martial arts world) setting. The same friendly young man, now the respected master of his own small martial-arts school, calm and confident: round thin black-framed glasses, big round dark eyes with a white catchlight, big ears that stick out at the sides, light warm skin with rosy cheeks, short dark brown hair tied up in a small neat topknot bound with a cyan ribbon, a warm relaxed smile. He wears a long black scholar-martial robe reaching his shoes, with a cyan trim along the cross collar and the sleeve cuffs, a cyan sash at the waist, black cloth shoes with white soles. He holds a calligraphy brush up in one hand, the other hand relaxed at his side. Palette, strictly: robe #1E1E26 with highlight #34343F and outline #0E0E14; trim, ribbon and sash #0891B2 with highlight #22B8D6; skin #F2C9A8 with shading #DFA07E; hair #3A2A20; glasses #111111; brush handle #8A5A3A with a black tip; soles #FFFFFF. Like a Stardew Valley style character sprite blown up large: crisp pixel edges, selective dark outlines, hue-shifted shading with cool shadows and warm highlights, soft light from the top left. Bold simple shapes with about 14 colours so it still reads clearly when shrunk to 90 pixels tall. Full body, front view, standing, centred, filling about 75% of the image height. A small flat pixel shadow under the feet. Background: one flat solid colour #E6E6EA, nothing else. Square image. No text, no letters, no Chinese characters, no numbers anywhere. No watermark, no signature, no frame, no border. No anti-aliasing blur, every pixel the same size, no gradients, no 3D render, no photo, no green anywhere, no teal, no extra characters, no clutter.
